about: Produced once, before the pure UI Flow helpers moved out of preview.js, by evaluating the preview.js named in `source` in node:vm (as test_authority_inspector.mjs does) on the inputs stored here.
Do not regenerate these expectations from flow-canvas-geometry.js: they prove the move kept every output identical.
Encoding: {"$map": [[k, v]]}, {"$set": [...]}, {"$undefined": true} and {"$number": "NaN"|"Infinity"|"-Infinity"|"-0"} stand for values JSON cannot hold.
flows[].fromPreview holds values computed by preview.js code that does not move (getCanvasMetrics, createDisplayRoutePositionMap, getEdgeLabelScale); the test feeds them back as inputs.

flows.name: mixed-phone-flow
flows.note: Legacy phone prototype (no flow.viewport) with explicit, position, layout.position, invalid and missing positions, a route-level viewport, measured preview sizes, stored (dragged) positions, decision/state flow nodes, key/reference/hidden/missing flowLine values, aggregated transitions, global/return/condition kinds, a self loop, reverse pairs, same-column bypasses in both directions and labels that collide.

flows.name: desktop-fallback-grid
flows.note: flow.viewport names only the desktop formFactor, so every frame is the 1280x800 fallback and no route has a position: the fallback grid pitch is derived from the desktop card and frames overlap vertically.

flows.name: tablet-declared-size
flows.note: flow.viewport declares a tablet size and one route overrides it with its own viewport, so frames have two sizes.
